name: CYBERKONG - cwcGamJam2021
author: osacris
description:
by Osacris (a French Game Jammer)

This is my entry for the CWC Game Jam of June/July 2021! My interpretation of the theme 'modernizing a classic' is to remake the GameWatch DONKEYKONG with modern approach.
I did this project solo. And i have lot of fun ....
That is a very good experience ;
.
